parameters.query: SELECT Id, Name, Type, Amount, CurrencyIsoCode, Annual_Contract_Value_with_Downpayment__c, ACV_in_USD__c, ACV_with_Downpayment_Corporate_Currency__c, CloseDate, CreatedDate, POR_Record__c, R360_Record__c, Pre_Migration_Annual_Spend__c, Current_Annual_Subscription__c, Current_Annual_Support__c, Previous_System_Opportunity_Amount__c, Services__c, Hardware__c, Contract_Length__c, Contract_Start_Date__c, SDR_Source__c, Deployment_Type__c, Support_Included__c, SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c, SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.Deployment_Type__c, Number_of_Touches_Calls_Emails__c, (SELECT Id, TaskSubtype, Type, Activity_Type__c, Status, Subject, ActivityDate, CreatedDate, CompletedDateTime, Completed_Date_Time__c, WhoId, CallType, OwnerId, TYPEOF Owner WHEN User THEN Name, Email, Profile.Name, UserRole.Name, Department, Title, Record360_User__c, Slack_ID__c ELSE Name END, Gong__Gong_Activity_Id__c, Gong__Meeting_Prospect_Canceled__c, Outreach_Attributed_Sequence_Name__c, Outreach_State__c FROM Tasks WHERE IsDeleted = FALSE AND Status = 'Completed' LIMIT 200), (SELECT Id, Subject, Type, EventSubtype, Activity_Type__c, ActivityDate, ActivityDateTime, Location, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, WhoId, OwnerId, TYPEOF Owner WHEN User THEN Name, Email, Profile.Name, UserRole.Name, Department, Title, Record360_User__c, Slack_ID__c ELSE Name END, Gong__Gong_Activity_Id__c, Gong__Meeting_Prospect_Canceled__c FROM Events WHERE IsDeleted = FALSE LIMIT 200), Number_of_Locations__c, NumUsers__c, Product_Family__c, ProductFamilyText__c, LeadSource, Sales_Engineer__c, Sales_Engineer__r.Name, Sales_Engineer__r.Email, Sales_Engineer__r.Slack_ID__c, SDR__c, SDR__r.Name, SDR__r.Email, SDR__r.Slack_ID__c, AE__c, AE__r.Name, AE__r.Email, AE__r.Slack_ID__c, (SELECT TeamMemberRole, UserId, User.Name, User.Email, User.Slack_ID__c FROM OpportunityTeamMembers), (SELECT Product2.Name, Product2.Deployment_Type__c, Product2.Family FROM OpportunityLineItems), Account.Id, Account.Name, Account.Industry, Account.Sub_Industry__c, Account.Website, Account.BillingCity, Account.BillingState, Account.BillingCountry, Account.BillingPostalCode, Account.NumberOfEmployees, Account.Num_Closed_Won_Opportunities__c, Account.Num_of_Locations__c, Account.Total_Locations__c, Account.AccountSource, Account.Syrinx_Cloud_Customer__c, Owner.Name, Owner.Email, Owner.Slack_ID__c, Owner.Title, Owner.Department, Owner.Profile.Name, Owner.UserRole.Name, Owner.Manager.Name, Owner.Manager.Email, Owner.Manager.Slack_ID__c FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = TRUE AND IsClosed = TRUE AND CloseDate = TODAY AND Annual_Contract_Value_with_Downpayment__c > 0 ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 50
